mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, description, start_at, end_at, all_day, recurrence_rule, created_at, updated_at FROM events WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ( (recurrence_rule IS NULL AND start_at <= #{toBoundary} AND end_at >= #{from}) OR (recurrence_rule IS NOT NULL AND start_at <= #{toBoundary}) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO events (user_id, title, description, start_at, end_at, all_day, recurrence_rule, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{allDay}, #{recurrenceRule}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE events SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt}, all_day = #{allDay}, recurrence_rule = #{recurrenceRule}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM events WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
